desc:
Experience a mostly COOP retro-styled Jujutsu Kaisen fighting game where every battle is yours to shape.
Playing with friends is heavily recommended(if you have any :P)
Please leave a feedback if you have any(can easily be done with the UI on the right side of your screen)
🔥 INITIATION
Gears up with people or alone to survive waves of cursed spirits, awaken random Cursed Techniques, and grow stronger after every wave. Choose powerful upgrades, unlock rare abilities, obtain Cursed Tools, and face terrifying bosses!

⚖️ CULLING GAME
Enter one of three deadly colonies and fight for survival. Hunt curses, eliminate rival sorcerers, earn points, and discover powerful abilities scattered throughout the world. Only the strongest will remain.


Unique Cursed Techniques and Domain Expansions

Destructible environments

Freestyle combat with powerful abilities

Rare traits, upgrades, and Cursed Tools

PvE survival and PvP battles


⭐ Favorite the game and join our group for future updates!
